name: Spirit Rangers
description: Native American siblings Kodi, Summer and Eddy have a secret: They’re "Spirit Rangers" who help protect the national park they call home!

videos.title: Rumble Mountain Rumble / Eagle Eye View
The Three Sisters / The Lacrosse Boss
Distracted by the Gecko / Belly of the Beast
Wor is Wolf / The Big Bad Buffalo
Not Your Opossum Mascot / Prickly Pride
Tricksters Steal the Sun / Spirit Kittens
videos.overview: Coyote and the Skycedar siblings tangle with a wily Trickster Trio. / Watching over a mountain lion spirit's kittens shows Eddy how much work pets can be.

videos.title: River Ruckus / Sailing Stones
videos.overview: Kodi, Summer and Eddy learn to go with the flow when a flood hits the park. / The kids plan a stakeout to see who's been moving the desert rocks around.

videos.title: Spirit Rangers Blast Off! / Lizard's Lost and Found
videos.overview: The Spirit Rangers shoot for the stars to get Coyote unstuck from the sky. / DeeDee asks her grandkids to help search for a missing museum artifact.

videos.title: Chief of the Day / Vulture Rock
videos.overview: Dealing with dust devils, the siblings discover that leaders come in all shapes and sizes. / Next, they hurry to warn a vulture spirit about an explosion.

videos.title: Moose on the Loose / The Big Stink
videos.overview: Visiting moose spirit Deneege quickly starts to miss his northern home. / Kodi puts on an art show with a creative — and very confident — stinkbug.

videos.title: Slow and Steady Eddy / Salmon Where Are You?
videos.overview: At a Spirit Park relay race, Eddy wonders if he'll be able to keep up. / The Skycedar kids' search for salmon takes them on a ride through the rapids.

videos.title: Deuces, Gooses / Frog Concert Chaos
videos.overview: Summer, Eddy and Kodi encourage a goose family to fly north for the season. / A new frog friend helps the Spirit Rangers get ready for a history hike.

videos.title: A Tale of Tails / Say It Don't Spray It
videos.overview: A legendary Maori lizard spirit visits the park. / Summer is excited to meet baby skunk Lily, but Lily's parents make a stink about her personal space.

videos.title: Rattle Trap / Home Squawk Home
videos.overview: Someone is trapping the park's rattlesnakes — letting mice run wild in DeeDee's garden! / Condor spirit Ruby brings rock 'n' roll vibes from the big city.

videos.title: Water Protectors
videos.overview: The Spirit Rangers face an epic fight to protect the park and the nearby ocean when the Trickster Trio unleashes a stream of toxic goo from an oil pipe.

videos.title: Spirit Park Secrets
videos.overview: Some ocean friends are trapped in tide pools! Can the Spirit Rangers figure out a way to free them without spilling their secret to Mom and Dad?

videos.title: Crabs in a Bucket
videos.overview: The Spirit Rangers help three cranky crabs build a sand sculpture that represents all of them. But first, they'll have to get them to stop fighting.

videos.title: Surfing Shark
videos.overview: Summer and Kodi want to go surfing with a shark — but Eddy's afraid! Can he overcome his fears and make a new friend?

videos.title: Kodi's Old Shoes
videos.overview: The Spirit Rangers help Fox train for a race against Rabbit. Meanwhile, Kodi is worried his old sneakers will slow him down in the Jim Thorpe Fun Run.

videos.title: Finding True North
videos.overview: When the North Star goes missing, everyone gets turned around without her light to guide them — including the Spirit Rangers!

videos.title: The Great Swordfish
videos.overview: Summer wants to play ball with the Swordfish People on Swordfish Day, but it goes against their tradition to let an outsider join.

videos.title: Digging Deeper
videos.overview: A big, scary monster keeps digging tunnels that could destroy the park, and the Spirit Rangers need their mole spirit friend's help to get it to stop.

videos.title: Stuck On You
videos.overview: Kodi makes friends with a flip-happy frog who needs a partner for the Frog Olympics. But even best froggy friends need a little space sometimes!

videos.title: Xutash Harvest
videos.overview: It's Leaf Day, and all the leaf-eaters are gathering for a yummy vegetarian feast. But meat-eater Coyote feels like he doesn't belong.

videos.title: Tiny But Mighty
videos.overview: When a fire spreads throughout the forest, the critters need someone big and strong to put it out. So why is a tiny spider volunteering?

videos.title: Potlatch Problem
videos.overview: It's time for a potlatch party... but all the huckleberry jam jars have gone missing! Could it be the work of the Trickster Trio?

videos.title: Finding Family
videos.overview: When the Spirit Rangers find a lost baby chipmunk, they search the forest for her parents — with two frantic wolves chasing after them.

videos.title: Summer's in Charge
videos.overview: A group of beavers on their way to the annual Canoe Journey need the Spirit Rangers' help. But an argument about who should be captain slows them down.

videos.title: Barracuda Brouhaha
videos.overview: The Spirit Rangers decide to clear the kelp forest, accidentally upsetting a school of barracuda. Can an apology set things right?

videos.title: Wild Flowers
videos.overview: During a super bloom, Stink Bug wants to use the Spirit Rangers as muses for his paintings. But there's one rule: Don't crush the poppies!

videos.title: Sage Advice
videos.overview: A sick baby bear needs sage to heal his sniffles. There's just one problem: Someone's picked all of the sage in the park!

videos.title: Facing Fears
videos.overview: When a tiny seahorse steals Otter Woman's basket cap, the Spirit Rangers go on a mission to find it — even though it's dark and scary outside.

videos.title: The Great Oak Tree
videos.overview: The Spirit Rangers want to invite Great Oak Tree to their Elder Day celebration, but she doesn't seem as friendly as the other elders in their community.

videos.title: Blizzards and Blankets
videos.overview: A summer snowstorm? A polar bear in California? Something strange is going on with the climate — and it's up to the Spirit Rangers to figure out why.
